arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Directory whose application subdirectories hold the SQL scripts to analyse.

arguments.name: extensions
arguments.description: File extensions (starting with '.') of the scripts to analyse.

arguments.name: policy
arguments.description: Rules to report at each severity, as lists under 'warning', 'error' and 'stop' (for example insert, drop, truncate, delete, hardcoded, not_endwith_slash, accept); no rule is enforced when omitted.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when no error or stop finding was reported.

outputs.name: files_scanned
outputs.description: Number of script files analysed across all applications.

outputs.name: objects
outputs.description: Number of database objects found across all applications.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Number of findings across all applications.

outputs.name: stopped
outputs.description: True when a stop-severity rule halted analysis of an application.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Per-application results: application, path, files_scanned, objects, findings, stopped and report (HTML report path).
